title: 常青边线

source.season: 公开系列／产品与造型研究；具体系列见来源

reference_scope_zh: 参考图中可观察：长剪裁外层与饱和绿小面积对照。颜色、长度、分割和搭配重新设计。
detail: Forest-green cotton-nylon short coat with exaggerated storm lapel, ivory compact rib polo, matching deep-green wide below-knee trousers with an original detachable ivory front pleated skirt panel, plain white court shoes. Tailored outerwear and pleat-over-trouser tension, no crocodile logo.

title: 橘色抢七

source.season: 公开系列／产品与造型研究；具体系列见来源

detail: Apricot-orange structured cropped cotton-pique polo with original white angular collar and navy curved side seam, navy sharply pleated short skort over hidden opaque shorts, white fine socks and orange-white low court shoes. Alter colour blocks and skirt construction; no brand marks.

source.season: 公开系列／产品与造型研究；具体系列见来源

title: 珊瑚唱片

source.season: 公开系列／产品与造型研究；具体系列见来源

Re-space stripe rhythm and reverse the reference skirt volume into trousers.

title: 蓝调合成器

source.title: Issey Miyake Spring 2024 Ready-to-Wear Collection | Vogue

reference_scope_zh: 参考图中可观察：对角包裹与细褶形成的离身空间。颜色、长度、分割和搭配重新设计。

title: 栗色缰线
reference_scope_zh: 参考图中可观察：皮革长线、立领与修长下身。颜色、长度、分割和搭配重新设计。
